title: Petrunko
intent: An instrumental reading: low pulse gives way to the exposed repeating upper figure and build, then strong bass-and-drum replies. Do not mislabel the upper figure as singing.

separation.seedScope: One torch seed at the start of the full 22-recording inventory order; not reset per song.

drumClasses: not measured; source labels refer to separated stems, not kick/snare classification

analysis.sourceTimestampConvention: Measured onset estimates preserved; no grid snapping or automatic contact selection.
